name: Khau papa
summary: Khẩu papa is a cake of Mường Thanh tám rice, likened to the lowland bánh nếp.
howToEat: Ask for it beside khẩu cắm and khẩu háng, the other tám-rice dishes.
seoTitle: Khau papa in Dien Bien Phu — a nếp cake
seoDescription: Khẩu papa is a cake of Mường Thanh tám rice, likened to the lowland bánh nếp.
